# AUB Analysis

## Situation Assessment
- **Baseline State**: Fully degenerate (0% exposure across all 19 folds)
- **Opportunity**: Any position-taking strategy with positive OOS will dominate
- **Lane**: `ost_v62_unified` — fresh unified baseline requiring diverse candidates

## Recommended Candidates

```
python run_candidate.py --lane ost_v62_unified --strategy momentum_cross --lookback 20 --threshold 0.01 --max_exposure 0.3
python run_candidate.py --lane ost_v62_unified --strategy mean_revert_zscore --window 10 --zscore_entry 2.0 --max_exposure 0.25
python run_candidate.py --lane ost_v62_unified --strategy vol_target --target_vol 0.15 --rebal_freq 5 --max_exposure 0.4
```

## Rationale

| Candidate | Why Selected |
|-----------|--------------|
| `momentum_cross` | Captures trending regimes; 20-day lookback balances noise vs. signal |
| `mean_revert_zscore` | Exploits short-term dislocations; z=2.0 entry filters weak signals |
| `vol_target` | Risk-parity approach; 15% target vol with dynamic sizing |

All three enforce non-zero `max_exposure` to guarantee position-taking and break degeneracy. Diversity across momentum/reversion/vol-targeting ensures at least one regime-match across the 19 folds.
